title: Russell's old light-wood clarinet and the Sidney Bechet pawn-shop story
summary: Russell shows an old ivory-and-brass-keyed clarinet part; Emile hasn't played anything like it, and Russell tells of Bechet playing a parade on one.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Yeah. Yeah. Well, Neely, we brought some clarinets down here to show you. Ralph's got a 13p. Here's just a part of one. Did you ever see one like that? Made out of light colored wood?
Well, this is a Chinese instrument.
Oh, is that what it is? Yeah, this is a Chinese instrument. Something like a Chinese thing, but I don't think that is. I think it's a regular clarinet.
I don't know if this is a Chinese instrument.

It looks something like those Chinese ones, but I think they're smaller. They use a double reed. I used to have one of those little horns, a muset or something they call it. That looks like about the regular length. For the lower joint and the bell. That may be a hundred years old or so. I don't know.
Some fellow collects antiques picked it up and I gave him five dollars for it.
Well, I'll tell you. I believe you made a wonderful deal.

I only got part of it, of course. That's real ivory on it and funny old brass keys. Somebody told me once a story about Sid. Paul Barber and I believe talked about it. Once Sidney Bechet was going to play a parade or funeral uptown. He didn't have a clarinet that was usually in the pawn shop or something. So he went in the pawn shop and they got one of these old yellow ones. I think Raymond Burke had one something like this too. And they said it only had three or four keys on it. What other key? This is all of it? That's all I got. There's another joint that should be with it. Yeah. I picked it the same time I picked up part of an old flute. That's part of a flute though. Uh-huh, yeah. That's the same kind of wood only that's a little, that's been cleaned up a little.
But that's part of a regular flute. But they said Sidney Bechet once played a parade with one of those light colored ones like that. That only had maybe three or four keys or something on it.

Oh. Well look how the keys fit something there, do I? Yeah. You like that? Direct. Well you can say what you want and do what you want. Old time things is not fancy, but it's there. Yeah it works. It's there. Now look how them keys all fit on that thing. Look at that, look.
That lasted over a hundred years, I've met.
Oh man, I'm going to tell you for this here, either one of them, I don't remember these. I don't.
You never had, never played on anything like that?
You saw anybody like the T.O.s or Locke, or nobody you ever saw? No, no I never.
Before their time I guess too.
